title: Rapoo VT3 Gen-2 Wireless Gaming Mouse $41.99 Delivered @ LH-RAPOO-US-DirectStore via Amazon AU
body:
Deal: Rapoo VT3 Gen-2 Wireless Gaming Mouse $41.99 Delivered @ LH-RAPOO-US-DirectStore via Amazon AU

[jbool295] kinda small (for me); I got the max a year or so ago. https://www.eloshapes.com/ pretty good site to see how it is for yourself
[jv] Apply coupon, then $41.99.
VT3 showing as $29
MAX showing $43
after 40% off…
[superforever] I got the Rapoo VT9Pro4K from last deal, don't upgrade firmware, dead after upgraded, even successful.
But they sent me a replacement.
[Haunt] It's a good mouse for its price but too much flex on the plastic shell sadly. I grip from the sides when playing and its a bit squeaky, wish they would increase the quality of their shells. Also just feels really cheap. Other than that, amazing specs for the price (unbeatable actually at this price point), just don't know why they would cut corners on the shell, even a 10% price increase for better shells would still be good value.
[CaptOblivious] its a bit squeaky
It's a mouse after all. Cant expect otherwise??
[Wickadz] Add a keyboard for 36 and get the mouse free? Lmao wild
[keksondecks] The keyboard doesnt look amazing but still a better price than the original deal lmao
[Wickadz] I'm sorry I am losing it right now, with the deal buying 3 mice is cheaper than 1 and the keyboard + mouse. $29 for 3. Christmas has come early
Add 2 of the max ones and a vertical for $29, donate the other two and you're good to go.
[Wickadz] @SourNipples: Legit, I had to double take. That rrp is total BS, however my current rapoo mouse is a few years old and going strong! Keen to see what actually rocks up
[Lord_Sif] Yeah insane, got 2 mice and keyboard for $34.
Edit: looks like quantity gone or changed. Wanted to check and cannot stack the same mice anymore.
[Ozone999] And you, my friend, are the true hero here.
[Wickadz] Bless. I hope I haven't dug my own grave with order cancellations
